title: Father's name: Willis or William Handy Young
summary: Lee and Willard sort out whether the father's name was William or Willis Handy Young and whether Handy relates to W.C. Handy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You said your father's middle name was Handy. Was that a family name or was that indicative of a relationship to any other Handy's we may have heard of?
No, I don't think so. His name was Willis Handy Young, and Lester's name was Lester Willis Young.
Oh, it was Willis? Not William?
No, William Handy ... my dad was William Handy, and Lester was Willis, though. Is that correct? I think so.
Yeah, that's right. He was Willis.
How about the Handy -- do you know where that came from?
No, I have no idea. I don't have a clue to the Handy. You're thinking of W.C.?
I don't really know. I don't really know. I wouldn't have a clue to that one.
